items.title: Ferrand Clementin Interview, 1973-08-02
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] ...It was Ridgely's band. You know Ridgely? Uh-huh. Yeah. From Medberg Street. Yeah, really. Medbay Ridley. [INTERVIEWEE] Yeah.

ctx.x: The preacher, so he wants to go to heaven. Everybody's going to go in there. You can see nothing. When he's gone there, he's going to go to heaven. When he's gone in there, when they make whoop-whoop, he went whoop-whoop. You know what? I'm sorry. I'm sorry. You see? Yeah. I wasn't even looked at the plane. But I didn't go too close. Yeah. Well, they used to have a...
You took that picture of that plane in Audubon. Yeah. He found a picture of a plane. It was Ridgely's band. You know Ridgely? Uh-huh. Yeah. From Medberg Street. Yeah, really. Medbay Ridley.
